Messages.Author: amy lynn renock
Messages.Body:
sorry micheal, i really wasn't very clear with either of my questions.
firstly about vamps, i definitely agree with your suggestion of rebecca,
tho she is a tad more costly than i like to go with. see, usually i work
with very cheap expendables (1-4 cap, embraces and allies with stealth
bonuses) and a coupla hard hitters, mainly muaziz (taking rebecca's
slot) and kalinda. Muaziz has both au and dom, +1 stealth *and* can't be
burned via blood hunt (yay). anyway that is all incidental. mainly i was
interested in finding vamps in the 1-4 range of any clan that might have
au or dom. there are a good number of vamps with sup au that are
capaicty 3 but the cheapest sup dom are 4's. i have relatively few
sabbat cards and so inquired into those (so i had a direction rather
than randomly buying packs).
my 2 question was pretty dorky now that i think about it and put rather
badly too. what i was really wanting to know was whether opposing
organisations of vampires (sabbat, camarilla or independent) could call
Blood Hunts (the action following diablerie, *not* the card action) on
each other. in a sense it was a goofy question, but i just have never
been able to shake the feeling that getting involved in the politics of
an opposing organisation, specifically diablerie retribution,
especially if only that groups vampires were involved (a camarilla vamp
diablerizes another camarilla vamp). do i make sense or simply insane,
or is this a case of the rules making a judgement that might conflict
with the backround. i don't know...blah blah blah...thanks for reading
this (anyone) and your help. :[
jason <all...@wcnet.org>

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Kurt Heyder wrote:
>
> > Any Methuselah can call a hunt after any diablerie, regardless of
> > the sect of the victim, the sect of the diabolist, or the sect(s)
> > of the vampires that that Methuselah controls.
>
> I assuming that sects include the Setites, Assamites, Ravnos and
> Giovanni. They can still call Blood/Wild Hunts, right?

Sects are: Sabbat and Camarilla and Independent.
Followers of Set, Assamites, Ravnos, and Giovanni are Independent.

Methuselahs call Hunts, not minions.
